title: 体育资产配置向大众开放 冠军产品降低门槛
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: I think the way that I came in, I was never able to get comfortable, never felt like I had job security, and once you get into kind of that mindset, you just keep striving for the next thing.
segments.zh: 我进入这个行业时，始终无法感到安心，总觉得没有职业保障。一旦陷入这种心态，就会不断追求下一个目标。

segments.en: So 10 years later, I was able to leave pretty accomplished.
segments.zh: 所以十年后，我离开时已经颇有成就。

segments.en: Awesome story, man. Talk to us about the champion fund. What is it and what are you trying to accomplish here?
segments.zh: 很棒的故事。跟我们聊聊冠军基金吧。它是什么？你想达成什么目标？

segments.en: Sure. So the champion fund is an interval fund, so it's an SEC registered fund, and the mission and vision here is to make the sports asset class accessible to every investor.
segments.zh: 好的。冠军基金是一只间隔基金，在SEC注册。使命和愿景是让体育资产类别对每位市场参与者都触手可及。

segments.en: Over the last decade or so, we've seen more and more news and more and more conversation around the sports asset class and how it's growing, but it's typically been institutional investors only.
segments.zh: 过去十年左右，我们看到越来越多关于体育资产类别的新闻和讨论，以及它如何增长，但通常只有机构市场参与者参与。

segments.en: And what we know, me personally being the product on the field as a player, transitioning into the investment world, having some ownership and operational experience for about seven years.
segments.zh: 而我本人，作为球员在场上亲历，后来转型**界，拥有约七年的所有权和运营经验。

segments.en: So I've been able to see this asset class from a bunch of different lenses, and the one thing that you realize is the biggest value catalyst for the asset class itself, the athletes, the fans, the coaches administrators, they create all the value, but get none of the equity in it.
segments.zh: 所以我从多个角度观察这个资产类别。你意识到最大的价值催化剂——运动员、球迷、教练和管理人员创造了所有价值，却得不到任何股权。

segments.en: So the champion fund is really a vehicle that makes that whole asset class accessible to every investor.
segments.zh: 因此，冠军基金是一个让整个资产类别对每位市场参与者都触手可及的工具。

segments.en: It's been a really good response. Right now we're out trying to secure those anchor investors, those institutional investors to kind of anchor the fund.
segments.zh: 市场反应很好。现在我们正在争取锚定市场参与者，即机构市场参与者，来为基金奠定基础。
